audit_summary.description: Written by report.py (audit.summary): the compact result of the mandatory audit; informative, re-derived by the writer, the gate and the per-version evaluation

unfinished.description: counts of unfinished work by kind (structure, scope, evaluations, chunks_missing, chunks_duplicate, chunks_stale, chunks_unreviewed, chunks_ungrounded, chunks_partial_categories, categories, candidates_unaccounted, candidates_unresolved, reverifications); zero kinds are omitted

title: handoff-verify report v1
description: `audit` and `scope_exclusions` are REQUIRED for a PASS: a report without them (or with an incomplete audit) is never PASS, whatever else it holds (audit.py re-derives everything it needs from the real source; nothing here is trusted: not the stored status, binding_summary, scope_audit, coverage.complete, source_ranges[].complete or the sha256 of a ledger)

work_locations.description: The directories the user gave at prepare time (omissions.py/prepare.py --location): absolute, added after the note directory and the recorded write cwd to the bases of the omission material; one that no longer exists makes the material unavailable

evidence_requests.description: Written by report.py: one entry per bound verify/gate check that did not pass (check.advice.evidence_request has the whole request); informative, re-derived by the writer, never changes a status

blockers.description: Written by report.py (audit.blockers): one entry per kind of unfinished audit work, from the counts of binding_summary.audit.unfinished, each with a fixed hint naming the command; informative, re-derived by the writer, never changes a status and never completes the audit

contract_reason.description: Written by report.py when the real verdict is outside its tool's contract (jevref.verdict_contract): the check is bound and recorded faithfully but never resolved

advice.description: Written by report.py (advice.py) on a bound, unresolved verify/gate check: what to try in the single re-verification (codes: evidence_off_subject, fix_fact, recheck_fact, remove_unsupported_detail, add_source_passage, add_direct_evidence, aux_condition_failed, result_mismatch, no_result); informative, never changes the status

evidence_request.description: Written by report.py (advice.evidence_request): what to do next to re-verify this check once (at most one re-verification per check), bound to the version of the note the writer demonstrated; informative, re-derived, never changes a status

scope_exclusions.description: R05: REQUIRED accounting of the scope filter (an empty list is a valid, audited zero; a missing or non-list value is missing accounting and blocks a PASS): candidate details excluded as outside the session scope (the user's requests): only a real jev_classify result out_of_scope with confidence strictly > 0.99 and decision auto (scope.py)

audit.description: Written by the author, judged by audit.py (item 11): one block per evaluation (write id + sha256 + prefix|session_end + run; equal-byte writes, modes and runs share nothing). The EXPECTED chunks are re-derived from the real source the way prepare.py chunks it; the report's own list cannot redefine them. A shortlist, `reviewed` booleans alone or a `complete` marker prove nothing. Honest limit: the registry and the ledger are editable files and a hash binds a snapshot only.

max_chars.description: the prepare.py --max-chars the chunks were made with (default 9000); another value makes the expected sha256s differ, so a stale review fails closed

registry.description: optional and never chosen by the report: the candidate registry of the source session is derived from the session (<first cwd>/.handoff-verify/<session>/audit-registry-<hash>.json) and established by preparation (prepare.py in its default run directory, audit.py template / register). The registries of the other representations of the session that the inputs demonstrate (a byte-identical copy or the original of the calls log / of the transcript the report names) are merged with it, and each of them needs its own established registry (a missing one is unfinished work that another one's registry does not replace). A report that names another path (not the registry of the session or of such a representation) is substituted accounting and blocks the PASS

ledger.description: optional: an omission obligation ledger of the session in addition to the ones preparation associated with it (omissions.py prepare-batch --ledger, audit.py template --ledger); every row of THIS session counts whatever its state (valid, invalidated, unavailable); a row whose source is positively another session (a ledger shared by several sessions; both transcripts readable with recorded session ids and none in common) does not, a row whose source is withheld, missing, unreadable, empty, malformed, metadata-deficient or otherwise undemonstrated does

evaluation.description: null = the whole transcript (a report without version identity)

chunks.description: exactly one record for every expected chunk

sha256.description: the sha256 of the chunk text as prepare.py wrote it (work/coverage.json chunk_list)

categories.description: the useful-detail categories (1-9) reviewed in this chunk: a COMPLETE review lists all nine; an unreviewed template lists none, and a shorter list is unfinished work counted by the audit (chunks_partial_categories)

basis.description: source-grounded evidence that the chunk was read: the uuid of a record of the chunk that lies in the window of the evaluation and an exact quote of THAT record's text (the audit re-derives both from the source)

window_partial.description: set by audit.py template: the window of the evaluation ends inside this chunk, so only the records (or the leading blocks of a record) inside the window count as evidence

categories.description: exactly one explicit outcome per category

outcome.description: null only in the unreviewed template (audit.py template)

candidates.description: candidates: the ids of EXACTLY the registered candidates of the category (all of them, none foreign, none repeated)

basis.description: no_candidate / not_applicable: the uuid of a record that lies in the window of the evaluation and an exact quote of THAT record's text (source-grounded; an empty window needs none)

unresolved.description: registered candidates declared as unfinished work (never PASS)

scope_audit.description: Written by report.py: the re-derived scope exclusions; an invalid one makes a PASS UNRESOLVED
